integrity: The counterexample is an exact rational calculation from the published formulas. The bundled rational-arithmetic replay is supplementary and is not used as a substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is a geometric counterexample to Proposition 1 and the restart-point construction; it does not claim failure of every complete VCG trajectory.

The construction is one-dimensional, which is sufficient because the source proposition explicitly covers full-dimensional compact convex subsets of arbitrary Euclidean dimension, including dimension one.
The claim concerns the public Optimization Online version inspected; a later revision could alter the auxiliary problem or proposition.
title: Voronoi-only slack can return boundary generators in VCG
